name: Cognitive Absorption
axiom: Absorbed people lose track of time and stop noticing the interface around the task.
trigger: A notification, promotional banner, or modal interrupts a writing or coding session that was running smoothly.

checklist.text: Silence non-urgent notifications, promotional banners, and modal interruptions during focused work.
Save in the background and report status without a dialog or a blocking spinner.
Offer a distraction-free mode and keyboard paths for sustained work.

antiPattern.violation: A code editor shows rating prompts and marketing toasts every ten minutes while someone is writing.
antiPattern.remediation: A focus mode hides ambient chrome, holds notifications, autosaves silently, and shows status in a quiet corner.

academicOrigin.title: Time Flies When You're Having Fun: Cognitive Absorption and Beliefs about Information Technology Usage
